$comment: Machine-executable QA definitions. Two sources merged: the 12-point short-form scan (ORG-MST-WFE-001 Section 4.5, IDs QA-SF-*) and the full Pre-Delivery QA Checklist (ORG-MST-SPEC-001 Section 9, IDs QA-SPEC-*). Where both cover the same rule the short-form ID is primary and the spec item is listed as alsoSatisfies. automation='full' means the engine decides pass/fail alone; 'assisted' means the engine verifies what it can and emits an operator attestation line; 'manual' means the engine can only surface the item for human signoff - it must never auto-pass these.

checks.rule: AGR conforms to agr.schema.json (draft 2020-12): required fields present, enums/patterns/const satisfied, no additional properties.
Header title, engagement line, footer package, artifact, and version match across header table, DCH, and footer.
DOCUMENT CONTROL HEADER banner label present; both DCH rows fully populated.
Document ID follows ORG-[CATEGORY]-[CODE]-[NNN] with a valid category/code pairing AND exists in the ID Registry.
Approval Status is one of the five controlled values AND matches Registry state; requested transition is legal per the transition map.
Review Date is ISO 8601 and within category default, or a logged documentation-owner override is attached.
Configuration callout present with Artifact, Description, Audience, Settings, and ID Pattern.
Every H1 has body content and, where required by the section schema, a subsection or table. Heading hierarchy has no level skips.
No em dashes, en dashes, emojis, or decorative unicode anywhere in any text run.
Zero warn (red) callouts and zero internal-only notes in client-facing output at promotion.
Every selection item uses the U+25CB glyph, consistent indentation, a descriptor line, and a four-option minimum. No checkboxes, plain bullets, or numbered lists for selections.

Every clauseInsertion block's rendered text matches the canonical clause (SHA-256 over canonical text, or canonical text with placeholders resolved from the request's placeholderMap). Paraphrase = ClauseResolutionError.
Output filename matches the ORG naming convention and the version in the filename matches the DCH version.

All bracketed placeholders resolved, or intentionally retained (null in placeholderMap) - retention permitted only in Draft mode for client-completion fields. Unknown bracket tokens warn in draft, fail on promotion. Known drift aliases always fail with the canonical suggestion.
Risk Acceptance Form included only when a deviation exists or is being requested. Engine verifies a deviation reference is present in evidenceReferences; operator attests the deviation is real.

Audit, MailItemsAccessed, retention, and item-level evidence claims are phrased as tenant-validation requirements unless a validated-evidence reference is attached. Practically: any block asserting audit capability must be a clauseInsertion of CL-006 or carry an evidenceReferences entry.
checks.governorFailureMode: Copilot frequently overclaims item-level chain of custody (ORG-MST-WFE-001 Step 5 table)

checks.rule: Restricted Content Discovery language does not overclaim connector behavior; RCD mentions must be the CL-007 clause or evidence-backed.
Approved users or pilot group identified before rollout materials are treated as final: the corresponding placeholder must be resolved (non-null) at promotion.
Support contact, escalation contact, designated security owner, and record storage location placeholders resolved at promotion.

Package manifest and ID Registry updated before final delivery. Engine emits the registry update payload and verifies post-update state; operator performs the update while the registry remains a workbook.

Artifact uses the v1.2 DCH, header table, callout, and footer standard. v1.1 metadata bands and v1.0 flat headers are structurally impossible in engine output; this check exists to catch config regressions.
Outline-document anti-pattern scan: reject sections that are primarily descriptive, contain 'describe your process here' style placeholders, or exist only to discuss future content.
checks.ruleSource: Master Workspace - Artifact Conversion Checklist Phase 4

checks.rule: Section titles match the artifact type's sectionSchema exactly and in order; no additions, omissions, or reordering. Types whose sectionSchema is not defined in the Spec refuse generation entirely.
Document ID embedded category and code segments match artifactType and the type's configured category.
Every clauseInsertion references a clauseId defined in clause-library.json, and all requiredClauses for the artifact type are present as clauseInsertion blocks.

Chrome free-text fields (context.owner/audience/preparedBy/client/engagement, renderingOptions.packageName) and every dataInputs.placeholderMap value contain only allowed characters: printable Basic Latin, printable Latin-1 Supplement excluding NBSP and soft hyphen, plus approved glyphs. Blocks in draft and promotion.

Every dataInputs.sections[].blocks[].blockType is one this engine version renders: paragraph, h2, h3, bulletList, table, clauseInsertion, radioQuestion, warnCallout, aggregationTable, copyReadyMessage. An aggregationTable is valid only with a live aggregationSource (clauseLibrary or placeholderDictionary). All ten block types in the AGR schema are now built. An unknown blockType fails closed with a reported check before rendering is attempted. Blocks in draft and promotion.
checks.ruleSource: ORG-MST-SPEC-001 Section 6; Arti-Generator Unsafe Block Exclusion Rule

checks.rule: Body-prose blocks (paragraph, h2, h3, bulletList, table) contain no unresolved bracketed placeholder tokens. Body prose is rendered verbatim (only clauseInsertion resolves placeholders), so a residual bracketed token would ship literally. QA-SPEC-07 inspects only placeholderMap and QA-SF-08 only prohibited characters, so neither catches this. Blocks in draft and promotion.
checks.$commentErrorCategory: Intentionally omitted: multi-category in code (MetadataViolation for a residual token; ConfigurationError on a misconfigured/pathological token-residue pattern). A single catalog value would mislabel one branch, so the per-branch code value stands.

checks.rule: artifactIdentity.layer matches the framework layer configured for the artifact type in artifact-types.json. Before this check, layer was the one required identity field the engine accepted on trust: it flows into artifact-manifest.json and nothing else validated it. Types with no configured layer are skipped because QA-ENG-02 already refuses them. Blocks in draft and promotion.
checks.ruleSource: ADR-002 AI Governance Program Structure; per-type layer assignment ratified 2026-08-01

manualOnly.$comment: Human judgment items the engine surfaces but never auto-passes. Rendered into the Optional Review Packet.
items: Findings are supported by evidence and accurately characterize the client environment.
Could another consultant use this artifact tomorrow without asking the author for clarification? (Operational Artifact Test)
Training acknowledgment included only when per-user signoff is required by the rollout design.
